title: Citizen app spec
description: The citizen app spec, as defined in The Software Field Guide, issue #84: the citizen-development-on-spec-rails chapter's YAML — the rails themselves. The spec declares the platform actions its rails grant and the behaviors its coverage declares; the citizen app manifest is judged against it at the PR gate, as an advisor. The spec is the agreement; the app drifts, the spec holds. This schema mirrors the shape rules of the Rego validator (policies/citizen); the validator additionally enforces the semantic rules a JSON schema cannot — reviewedOn a real calendar date not in the future — and the joins the gate performs against the manifest and the platform guardrail registry.

version.description: Version of the spec. Rails are versioned like the app they govern.

reviewedOn.description: Date the spec was last reviewed, YYYY-MM-DD. The validator flags dates in the future.

owner.description: The team that owns the spec. Rails without an owner are rails nobody maintains.

actions.description: The action rails: the platform actions this spec authorizes for the app. An action the app uses that the rails never granted is the app reaching outside its own spec.

coverage.description: The behaviors this spec's coverage declares. Every behavior a manifest component declares must be answered for here.
